messages.author: 3881fc99d0ad0e5c
messages.subject: Install failure
parts:
I am running R 2.14.2 (on a MacBook Air running OSX 10.7.3/, and when I try to install INLA I get a whole lot of warnings of the form
Warning: /private/var/folders/v7/kqg8nv5x073cxwlw92ysd8q80000gn/T/RtmpefJhi1/R.INSTALL131bd894/INLA/man/read.graph.Rd:3: All text must be in a section

At the end of the install I get
* DONE (INLA)
Error in FUN("inla.update"[[1L]], ...) :
  internal error -3 in R_decompress1
In addition: Warning message:
In FUN("inla.update"[[1L]], ...) :
  restarting interrupted promise evaluation

which then repeats every time I try to load the library. Any thoughts?
peter
